name: Bánh su sê Cù Lao Chàm
nameVi: Bánh su sê Cù Lao Chàm
summary: Bánh su sê is tapioca cooked with white sugar, filled with mung bean and shredded mature coconut, then tied in a banana leaf. The tie is how you tell it from bánh ít.
origin: Cham Islands. On Tân Hiệp for about 20 years as of 25 November 2014, learned from the mainland.
texture: The inventory cooks tapioca starch with water and white sugar for about half an hour, then mixes in shredded mature coconut. The filling is mung bean, soaked, cooked, pounded, and cooked again with white sugar. Peanut oil goes on the hands. The packet is banana leaf tied with a banana-leaf string. The tie is how you tell it from bánh ít, which is not tied. It is then steamed in an aluminum pot.
howToEat: From the pier baskets, with bánh ít. In November 2014 one household made this cake, and unsold cakes came back to the pier.
seoTitle: Bánh su sê Cù Lao Chàm — tied banana-leaf cake
seoDescription: Tapioca, coconut, and mung bean, tied in banana leaf, from the pier baskets on Tân Hiệp.
